value_definition: Model relative inverse-depth-like prediction: larger generally nearer, not metric distance, no absolute scale/calibration. Gray white=larger/nearer; black=smaller/farther. Orientation is model convention, not image luminance.
normalization: (raw-min)/(max-min); source-grid derived by bicubic align_corners=False; display clamp to [0,1]. Per-image normalization not cross-image distance.
